topic: take and drop a page reference on a vintage tree (pre-folio)
q: On a 4.19-era BSP kernel, pin a page for the duration of a DMA transfer and release it afterwards.
range: <= 5.15 (folio_put arrived in 5.16, folio_get in 5.17 - the folio API landed in batches, not in one release)
requires_tree: vintage BSP tree without the folio API; note that even on newer trees the folio symbols did not all appear together

corruptions.why: 5.17+. The folio API landed in batches - folio_put is one release older - so 'the folio API' is not a single version boundary.

forbidden: comparing a dma_addr_t against 0 to detect a mapping failure instead of calling dma_mapping_error
rubric: Uses get_page / put_page around the DMA mapping and checks dma_mapping_error. Does not use folio_get / folio_put, which this tree does not have.
